Borra Ravindra Reddy vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23

Author: J. Uma Devi

 The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.290 Of 2020

opennyai_summary.decision:
This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/A.1 and A.2, seeking to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.187 of 2019 dated 01.12.2019, on the file of the Podalakur Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 188 and read with Section 34 IPC.
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in a Criminal Petition No.6205 of 2019 filed by the petitioner therein, this Court passed an order dated 22.10.2019, quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Following the order passed in the aforementioned criminal petition and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in F.I.R.No.187 of 2019 dated 01.12.2019, on the file of the Podalakur Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 188 and read with Section 34 IPC as against the petitioners/A.1 and A.2.
No order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
